description: GENeSYS-MOD (Global Energy System Model) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by TU Berlin. The Global Energy System Model (GENeSYS‑MOD) is a linear cost-minimizing optimization model being developed at Technische Universität Berlin, Germany. The project was originally based on the OSeMOSYS framework and the first version was released in 2017 using GAMS. The codebase was later translated into Julia. Both versions and a representative dataset are available on GitHub. Coverage: user-defined regions (as stated on the fact sheet). The fact sheet classes it as: multi‑commodity optimization. Sectors: Electricity, Heat, Transport, Industry, Buildings,. Resolution: time Hour, geography NUTS1, federal states. Data availability is given as "some". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Apache-2.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
